text:
Predicates:
Footballer(x) ::: x is a football player.
LoanedOut(x, y) ::: x was loaned out to y.
PlaysFor(x, y) ::: x plays for y.
Brazilian(x) ::: x is Brazilian.
Club(x, y) ::: x is a football club named y.
BornIn(x, y) ::: x was born in year y.
KnownAs(x, y) ::: x is commonly known as y.
Premises:
Ailton(Silva) ∧ BornIn(Silva, 1995) ∧ KnownAs(Silva, Ailton) ::: Ailton Silva, born in 1995, is known as Ailton.
Footballer(Ailton) ::: Ailton is a football player.
LoanedOut(Ailton, Braga) ::: Ailton was loaned out to Braga.
PlaysFor(Ailton, Nautico) ::: Ailton plays for Nautico.
Brazilian(Ailton) ::: Ailton is a Brazilian footballer.
Club(Nautico, nautico) ∧ Club(Braga, braga) ∧ Club(Fluminense, fluminense) ::: Nautico, Braga, and Fluminense are football clubs.
Conclusion:
PlaysFor(Ailton, fluminense) ::: Ailton Silva played for Fluminense.
